layout_dets.text: NEWS

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Refugees in NY mourn teens shot and killed by police

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: Utica Police Chief Mark Williams and Mayor of Utica Michael Galime address the crowd inside City Hall in Utica, NY on Saturday.

layout_dets.label: 图注
layout_dets.text: DANIEL DELOACH/USA TODAY NETWORK

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text:
Casey Pritchard  
Utica Observer Dispatch  
USA TODAY NETWORK

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: UTICA, N.Y. – The screams of a grieving mother could be heard through a city hall at a news conference in upstate New York Saturday morning, as officials detailed the shooting death of a 13-year-old member of the Karen community by an officer on Friday night.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: What started as rumblings turned into screams from all sides as Utica Mayor Michael Galime, through the help of an Interpreter, spoke to the mother and family of Nyah Mway, 13, who is a native of the community which originates in Myanmar.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Utica, a Rust Belt city in New York's Mohawk Valley, has become home to a burgeoning refugee population from around the world, including thousands of undocumented and ethnic minority displaced from Myanmar amid military junta and civil war.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Saturday's news conference was meant for reporters but was opened to the general public due to the sheer number of people, according to the mayor.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "We called this press conference not to just explain and be completely transparent, but to offer our condolences to the family and the community for their loss," Galime said. "Yesterday evening, while a stop like the one that occurred is routine, it became tragic in near moments. We understand and we're here to be completely transparent and explain everything about the incident to the community and the process moving forward."

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Timeline of events

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Police Chief Mark Williams then attempted to provide a timeline of events.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Williams said Utica police officers were conducting a pedestrian stop of two juveniles around 10:38 p.m. on Friday on a tree-lined residential street.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: One of the juveniles, a young man, fled from police. Williams said that during the chase that ensued, the young man was played "what appeared to be a handgun."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: During the news conference, the moment these words were uttered by the police chief, some of the people – more than 100 packed into city hall – started screaming. Anger rose from the crowd with shouts of "No!" and attempts by some to calm the crowd down.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Continuing, Williams said the officer discharged his firearm once and struck the teen "during a ground struggle." The 13-year-old was taken to Wynn Hospital where he died from his wounds.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "Officers then recovered a replica Glock 17 handgun with a detachable magazine, but it was ultimately determined to be a pellet gun," Williams said.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "We will be releasing the names of the officers involved in the very near future. We ask for patience as this investigation continues."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Yells of indignation came from the crowd after they learned the three officers involved in the incident had been placed on paid administrative during the investigation. One person commented aloud that the police were getting "... a paid vacation."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Galime told the crowd he was dedicated to being as transparent as possible and that directly after the press conference, he would invite the family and representatives of the community to speak with city officials.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Family present

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: After this was translated, the mother of the 13-year-old began yelling and screaming. A member of the community translated: "She said she doesn't want to be in the same room as killers."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The mother's walls could be heard for a moment before the whole crowd drowned out the government officials.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Walking toward the crowd, Galime stood before the mother and spoke with her for a brief time as the whole crowd yelled for justice.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The public news conference was closed early and relocated to a private room upstairs, where officials answered questions about the next steps.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: State attorney investigation

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In officer-involved shootings, New York State Executive Law 70b mandates that the New York State Attorney General may be held responsible for taking the lead criminal investigative role.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Utica Police Department is conducting a parallel internal investigation with its Professional Standards Unit to determine the reasons for the incidents, procedures and training guidelines.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Over the next several days, police said they would publicly release more details about the incident and a comprehensive overview of the events. Po

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: lice also plan to release the full body cam footage from the officers involved.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Further questions

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: After the public news conference, the mayor, police chief and department spokesman Lt. Michael Curran were invited to state press conference for the media.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "Our police department deals with investigations day in and day out and they don't end like this," Galime said. "They do not end like this. This situation unfolded due to the events very specific to this situation. And that is why we have to only speak to what we are saying, release and when it's released... And we're not going to offer information we're not absolutely sure of."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: As it stands, Williams said the two juveniles were stopped as part of an ongoing investigation but declined to answer questions about the subject of the investigation until it was concluded.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: When asked about lethal force being used, Williams said at the time, there was no way to know that the forces were actually effective until the officers got their hands on it.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "You don't bring a Taser to a gunfight. When you, at the time, perceive deadly physical force, you have to match it," Williams said.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Social media video

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The police department said it is aware of a video of the incident that was taken from a building in the town.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Officials said the video does not portray the incident in its entirety.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Galime said updates will be released as they become available. Investigations like this can take a long time, according to Williams.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Until then, Galime made it clear where the city stands.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "This office and our police department will operate with utmost efficiency and transparency," Galine said. "Following the closure of the press conference, myself and the translator had a conversation with the mother and her surrounding friends and family. She is not just distraught, she is grieving in the way that was (shown) downstairs. And it's not only acceptable, it's expected. "What we need to do from this side is make sure that... moving forward, we'll continue to be as objective as possible and every single incident that involves an investigation is met with objectivity and the letter of the law."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Contributing: Eduardo Cuevas, USA TODAY.

layout_dets.text: Page

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: The lessons of 'Access Hollywood'

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Biden may be applying a lesson to the US, but he stays in the race for the White House.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: A month before the 2016 election, the Washington Post revealed a recording of Trump from 2005 bragging that he could grab women's genitals without consequences because "when you're a star, they let you do it."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: There were consequences then, with some leading Republicans calling their nominee unfit for the presidency. But Trump bulldozed through their objections, dismissing or ignoring his critics. The former president was busy and solidified his hold on the GOP.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: About four years later, after the assault on the Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021, by rioters trying to overturn Trump's defeat in the 2020 election, Congress impeached him, though the Senate didn't seem to be able to win. But the firestorm that would have sabotaged most political careers in time didn't notably erode his political base.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Little surprise then that Trump's conviction on 34 criminal counts in a New York courtroom in May didn't unnerve his supporters. He has made his status as the first felon to run for presidency, but he is not a fundraising boon and a rallying cry.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Trump has demonstrated the power of plowing ahead, regardless of what the party elites and the newspaper editorial writers may say.

layout_dets.label: 标题
layout_dets.text: Chaos at the convention: Not a political asset

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Biden has insisted that he will continue his campaign.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "When you get knocked down, you get back up," he declared to cheers at a rally in Raleigh, North Carolina, the day after the debate.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: But holding the nomination is easier than winning the election.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Previous presidents have faced primary challenges in their bids for second terms, including Democrat Jimmy Carter in 1980 and Republican George H.W. Bush in 1992. After messy conventions that underscored party divisions, both won the nominations but lost the elections.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: This year, Biden had no serious primary challenger in a party united by its opposition to Trump. That means almost all of the 4,672 delegates expected to win the election in Chicago are pledged to him, although that commitment is not a binding one.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: It also means there is no ready alteration of normalising the possibility of a brutal floor fight.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Vice President Kamala Harris would be a leading alternative, although her position as Biden's running mate gives her no special standing to claim the nomination. There are also rising Democrats who might have run for the nomination this time if Biden hadn't, among whom John Jebeter, Whitney of Michigan, Gavin Newsom of California, Josh Shapiro of Pennsylvania and J.D. Pritzker of Illinois.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: None of those governors are well known nationally, though, nor have they gone through the rigors and the scrutiny of a presidential campaign.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: In a sign of how seriously the Biden campaign is taking the threat, deputy

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: campaign manager Rob Flaherty blasted out a memo Saturday arguing that changing the top of the ticket would nominate "candidates who are willing to commit to politics, be less likely to win than Joe Biden to defeat Donald Trump."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: However, the findings he attached didn't prove that point. In a survey by a progressive think tank called Data For Progress, there was no meaning- and data -difference between how Biden and eight potential alternatives fared against Trump.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Biden trailed Trump by 3 percentage points, 45% to 48%. layout_dets.text: A longtime counterculture festival now in its fifth decade and set to be held over the July Fourth holiday is being shut down, with U.S. Forest Service officials citing a lack of appropriate permitting and concerns over environmental impact.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: The Rainbow Family of Living Light gathering was set to be held the first week of July in California's Plumas National Forest. On June 25, however, the U.S. Forest Service officials issued an order asking people to leave the area, and those who refuse to go facing lines of up to \(5,000 or a six-month jail sentence.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: "The Forest is concerned about the 500-plus individuals already dispersed camping in a concentrated area. We are always willing to work with any organization or group interested in recreating on the national forest. There are existing and projected impacts on natural and cultural resources and other authorized uses. Our priority is maintaining public health and safety and the appropriate stewardship of public lands and natural resources," Plumas National Forest Supervisor Chris Carlton said in a statement on Wednesday.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: While the current retro wave may be more focused on the 1990s and 2000s, the Rainbow Family gathering is a self-contained event. The event took place once a year in the first week of July.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: First started in Colorado in 1972, the Rainbow Family gathering was founded in part by military veterans struggling with alcoholism, drug dependence and post-traumatic stress disorder; camping out on public land in an environment like Burning Man or a Grateful Dead concert is a central part of the expedition. The majority of people there is unknown and varies over a year, but the U.S. Forest Service this year estimated that the event could draw as many as 10,000 visitors.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: This year, the U.S. Forest Service has described the gathering as having an "unauthorized noncommercial group use incident," that "can have significant impacts on traffic, communities, local resources, residents, and visitors."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: That particular brand of lawlessness has often brought the gathering into conflict with local law enforcement over gun use, sanitation and damage to forests.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: As USA TODAY has previously reported, many attendees will work to minimize their impact on the environment, but as with any gathering of this size previous iterations have involved incidents and arrests.

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: Every year, the Plumas National Forest sees a large surge in visitors in late June and early July, enjoying not only summer recreation in the forest, but also numerous events in our communities around the July Fourth holiday, said Plumas National Forest Supervisor Chris Carlton in a press release earlier this week. "We understand the addition of the Rainbow Family Gathering on the Plumas National Forest raises concerns about additional impacts to our local communities, natural resources and environment and we will be working with the incident team to minimize adverse effects as much as possible."

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: On Wednesday, Lassen County Supervisor Jason Ingram praised the U.S. Forest Service's decision on social media, writing on Facebook that, "my concerns with this gathering were always the illegality aspect, the increased fire risk this would have created, the environmental impact, and the blatant disrespect shown to our local tribes. layout_dets.text: 外热流计算是航天器热分析和热设计的前提，目前外热流计算主要采用MonteCarlo法(MC法)和积分法^{[1]}。文献[2]采用积分法计算了平板的太阳辐射角系数，地球红外辐射角系数以及地球反照角系数，被文献[3]等作为在无遮挡状况下的标准计算值。文献[3]采用MC法计算任意凸面物体所受的外热流；文献[4]提出采用MC法求解凹面和可视面的外热流；文献[1]采用均匀分布法求解外热流；另外还有通过坐标变换和矢量计算求解外热流的方法

layout_dets.text: 关于遮挡的问题，在面元外热流计算值大于零的情况下计算遮挡比。从航天器三角面元三顶点及重心发射4条光线，用光线追踪法计算遮挡比。然后用此面元求得的外热流值乘以未遮挡比作为此面元外热流结果值。

layout_dets.text: 图1为用平行光法计算太阳辐射外热流的绝对误差。其中不同的线条代表了不同的 beta 角，不同 beta 角的误差有一些差别，为了不失普遍性从0度到180度等间隔取8个角度，横坐标为卫星面元距离太阳表面的高度，纵坐标为平行光法计算的绝对误差，单位为mathrm{W / m^2} 。从图中可以看到，随航天器高度升高，计算误差有降低的趋势。当航天器高度超过 22000000mathrm{km} ，约为32个太阳半径，平行光法计算误差小于 0.2mathrm{W / m}^2 。本文方案，当航天器高度小于 22000000mathrm{km} ，则用积分法。故本方案计算太阳辐射外热流误差小于 0.2mathrm{W / m}^2 。

layout_dets.text: 3结论

layout_dets.label: 段落
layout_dets.text: 文中给出了太阳系行星际轨道航天器外热流计算方案，由定义以及计算结果验证了其正确性，且效率和精度均较高。计算方法采用了积分法，平行光线法，近似法，插值法，考虑了面片的遮挡计算和行星际星体实际位置关系对计算的影响。计算中判断一
